author: Dean Inge
quote: The soul is dyed with the color of its leisure thoughts.

quote: Action is the normal completion of the act of will which begins as prayer. That action is not always external, but it is always some kind of effective energy.

author: Dean Inge
quote: We tolerate shapes in human beings that would horrify us if we saw them in a horse.

author: Dean Inge
quote: Let none of us delude himself by supposing that honesty is always the best policy. It is not.

author: Dean Inge
quote: A cat can be trusted to purr when she is pleased, which is more than can be said for human beings.

author: Dean Inge
quote: It was said that Mr. Gladstone could persuade most people of most things, and himself of anything.

author: Dwight L. Moody
quote: We are told to let our light shine, and if it does, we won't need to tell anybody it does. Lighthouses don't fire cannons to call attention to their shining- they just shine.

author: Dwight L. Moody
quote: Faith makes all things possible... love makes all things easy.

author: Dwight L. Moody
quote: There are many of us that are willing to do great things for the Lord, but few of us are willing to do little things.

author: Dwight L. Moody
quote: Preparation for old age should begin not later than one's teens. A life which is empty of purpose until 65 will not suddenly become filled on retirement.

author: Dwight L. Moody
quote: A good example is far better than a good precept.

author: Dwight L. Moody
quote: The Bible will keep you from sin, or sin will keep you from the Bible.

author: Dwight L. Moody
quote: We talk about heaven being so far away. It is within speaking distance to those who belong there. Heaven is a prepared place for a prepared people.

author: Dwight L. Moody
quote: I have had more trouble with myself than with any other man.

author: Dwight L. Moody
quote: Where I was born and where and how I have lived is unimportant. It is what I have done with where I have been that should be of interest.

author: Dwight L. Moody
quote: A man ought to live so that everybody knows he is a Christian... and most of all, his family ought to know.

author: Dwight L. Moody
quote: We can stand affliction better than we can prosperity, for in prosperity we forget God.

author: Dwight L. Moody
quote: I know the Bible is inspired because it inspires me.

quote: God never made a promise that was too good to be true.

quote: If I take care of my character, my reputation will take care of me.

quote: Character is what a man is in the dark.

quote: Church attendance is as vital to a disciple as a transfusion of rich, healthy blood to a sick man.

author: Dwight L. Moody
quote: God doesn't seek for golden vessels, and does not ask for silver ones, but He must have clean ones.

author: Dwight L. Moody
quote: There's no better book with which to defend the Bible than the Bible itself.

author: Dwight L. Moody
quote: Never think that Jesus commanded a trifle, nor dare to trifle with anything He has commanded.

author: Dwight L. Moody
quote: Death may be the King of terrors... but Jesus is the King of kings!

author: Dwight L. Moody
quote: Give me a man who says this one thing I do, and not those fifty things I dabble in.

author: Dwight L. Moody
quote: No man can resolve himself into Heaven.

author: Michelangelo
quote: The greater danger for most of us lies not in setting our aim too high and falling short; but in setting our aim too low, and achieving our mark.

author: Michelangelo
quote: The true work of art is but a shadow of the divine perfection.

author: Michelangelo
quote: I saw the angel in the marble and carved until I set him free.

author: Michelangelo
quote: Every block of stone has a statue inside it and it is the task of the sculptor to discover it.

quote: My soul can find no staircase to Heaven unless it be through Earth's loveliness.

quote: If people knew how hard I worked to get my mastery, it wouldn't seem so wonderful at all.

author: Michelangelo

author: Michelangelo
quote: Lord, grant that I may always desire more than I can accomplish.

author: Michelangelo
quote: There is no greater harm than that of time wasted.

author: Michelangelo
quote: Faith in oneself is the best and safest course.

author: Michelangelo
quote: If in my youth I had realized that the sustaining splendour of beauty of with which I was in love would one day flood back into my heart, there to ignite a flame that would torture me without end, how gladly would I have put out the light in my eyes.

author: Michelangelo
quote: Trifles make perfection, and perfection is no trifle.

author: Michelangelo
quote: A beautiful thing never gives so much pain as does failing to hear and see it.

author: Michelangelo
quote: The promises of this world are, for the most part, vain phantoms; and to confide in one's self, and become something of worth and value is the best and safest course.

author: Michelangelo
quote: It is necessary to keep one's compass in one's eyes and not in the hand, for the hands execute, but the eye judges.

author: Michelangelo

author: Michelangelo
quote: From such a gentle thing, from such a fountain of all delight, my every pain is born.

author: Michelangelo
quote: The marble not yet carved can hold the form of every thought the greatest artist has.

author: Henry Ford

author: Henry Ford

author: Henry Ford

author: Henry Ford
quote: The man who will use his skill and constructive imagination to see how much he can give for a dollar, instead of how little he can give for a dollar, is bound to succeed.

author: Meister Eckhart

author: Meister Eckhart

author: Meister Eckhart
quote: What we plant in the soil of contemplation, we shall reap in the harvest of action.

author: Meister Eckhart

author: Meister Eckhart
quote: Do exactly what you would do if you felt most secure.

author: Meister Eckhart

author: Meister Eckhart

author: Meister Eckhart

author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

author: Friedrich Nietzsche

author: Friedrich Nietzsche
